scope: Sanitized NDEF shape from one owned, already-active Mainland China GS3 read with an owned iPhone. No full serial, link identifier, screenshot, account data, key material, registration envelope, authentication payload, or glucose value is included.

verifiedRecordShape.recordKind: Text payload returned by Sugarman's NDEF extractor; the NDEF TNF/type was not retained in the private screenshot

inferences.claim: The 15-character second field is the sensor serial.
inferences.basis: Its value matched the owner-visible official-app sensor serial; the committed evidence omits it.

inferences.claim: The literal third field declares the six-character final-field length.
inferences.basis: Its numeric value equals the final field length in the owned observation and pinned reference example; the field semantics are not independently documented.

inferences.claim: The six-character final field may be the expectedId supplied to V3 registration decoding.
inferences.basis: It matches the owner-visible link code, but no legitimate nativeRegisterKey call arguments were observed.

notYetVerified: The same NDEF layout on a second sensor lot
The authentication ID supplied to the V3 authentication command
decision: Accept only this exact bounded shape for redacted identity classification. Do not persist or expose the link identifier as a parsed field, infer protocol support from NDEF, or send any sensor command.
